title: Qt: Use new style signal and slot connections for preferences
description:
After c68bf01794a36f491b3db11f4656c84d5be18007 we don't have
incomplete structures, so we can use new style signals and slots
which check that the connections can be made at compile time instead
of at runtime.

notes.body:
> After c68bf01794a36f491b3db11f4656c84d5be18007 we don't have incomplete structures,

After c68bf01794a36f491b3db11f4656c84d5be18007 we don't have incomplete structures *other than in epan/prefs.h, which has incomplete structure definitions for use in typedefs*. epan/prefs.h has incomplete structures because `struct preferences` is opaque outside epan/prefs.c and `struct pref_module` is opaque except in code that includes epan/prefs-int.h.

added 2 commits
  • fd6004fa - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 22cd0b3f - Qt: Use new style signal and slot connections for preferences
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18196/diffs?diff_id=1191420968&start_sha=c21bf8202507782186a363f871a6501980fed974)
This apparently works on newer Qt but not on Qt 6.4 or Qt 5 without calling Q_DECLARE_OPAQUE_POINTER() and some similar macros and I don't reckon it's really worth doing at the moment.
